rows.title: Re-importing a timeless jobs file whose to-dos or interviews have numeric (or repeated) ids adds another copy of each such job on every import
rows.summary: Now: importing the same file again skips the job when its to-dos or interviews have numeric or repeated ids. mergeImport's comparison (idsFrom in src/utils/jobMerge.js) takes the saved job's id for every entry whose id completeJob replaced (e.id !== the file's id), not only for entries that had no id. A changed to-do still makes the job a copy.

rows.title: Re-importing a timeless jobs file whose entries have "todos": null adds another copy of each such job on every import
rows.summary: Now: importing the same file with todos: null again skips the job. asOver keeps the file's todos as they are when they are not a list, which is how the job was saved, instead of turning them into []. Jobs already saved with todos: null by earlier imports match as well, with no data migration needed.

issues: R5-HUNT11-IMPORT-NULL-TODOS-DUPLICATE (5c7ab4af) regression: asOver now keeps a file's todos: null, so a saved job whose to-dos were emptied (a to-do added then deleted leaves todos: []) no longer matched the file's null, and each re-import of the timeless file added the job again; before 5c7ab4af that case was skipped. Same for a file with todos: [] over a job saved with todos: null. Fixed: no to-dos on both sides (null, missing or []) compares equal (noTodos in src/utils/jobMerge.js).
review.notes: Both fixes address the root cause: completeJob replaces numeric, empty or repeated sub-item ids (withOwnIds), and idsFrom now borrows the saved id wherever the completed id differs from the file's, aligned by index with readJob's output (readJob only filters, completeJob maps 1:1), so a changed to-do or a new/extra one still makes a copy and a genuinely new job (new id) is still added. Run 36656229288 proves both original tests fail first (4 and 2 failures) and pass. The null-todos fix left the null-vs-[] gap above; fixed with two added tests in r5-hunt11-job-import-null-todos.unit.mjs, fail-first proven in run 36669500161 (2 failures without, pass with), and all 10 job import/normalize/knowledge-docs files pass 63/63 plus lint. Sync merge and undo do not use mergeImport and are unaffected; timed (updatedAt) imports are unaffected. Fix commit 0403359 is on claude/wf-r5-hunt11-jobs only and still needs merging into r4-green/master.

notes: CI run 36656229288 (dispatch on 5c7ab4a): both fail-first jobs passed (subitem-ids failed 4 tests without its fix, null-todos failed 2), and the named job-import, normalize-job and knowledge-docs files passed 66/66, plus lint. docs/knowledge/07-job-tracker.md is updated.
